game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Archery Yard, the garrison archery yard: the knight must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected keys into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the wall banner.
theme: The Kingdom – Archery Yard: the garrison archery yard
core_gameplay_loop: In Archery Yard, repeat each round: Drag collected keys into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the wall banner. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the crate_b value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the wall banner using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the wall banner is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Archery Yard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow scouts in Archery Yard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 21.
